name: Notes.io
description_en:
Notes.io is a browser-based text-note and short-link sharing service. Its official page says a note can be shared without creating an account and without installing an app.

It is a narrow sharing utility. Treat access control, durability and editing/recovery as unverified before using it for material that matters.
description_zh:
Notes.io 是基于浏览器的文字笔记与短链接分享服务。官网说明分享笔记无需创建账户，也无需安装应用。

它属于用途较窄的分享工具。用于重要资料前，应把访问控制、长期保存与编辑／恢复能力视为尚未核实。

core_features.explanation_zh: 无需安装即可在线书写笔记。

core_features.explanation_en: Share text using a shortened note link; size conditions apply.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过笔记短链接分享文字，受大小条件限制。

en: Share a short public instruction note.
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Hosted browser service requiring internet access.
Deployment.zh: 需要联网的托管浏览器服务。

steps.en: Draft non-sensitive text and retain an independent copy.
steps.zh: 起草非敏感文字并保留独立副本。

steps.en: Obtain a short link within the documented size condition and inspect the recipient view.
steps.zh: 按文档大小条件取得短链接，并检查接收者视图。

items.en: The page warns that notes above 18 KB cannot be shortened without reducing content or signing in. Keep the original elsewhere, and verify the recipient link before relying on it. Password protection, deletion controls, retention and service recovery were not established.
items.zh: 页面提示超过 18 KB 的内容需缩短或登录，才能生成短链接。建议在其他位置保存原文，依赖链接前核对接收者视图。未确认密码保护、删除控制、保留期或服务恢复能力。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free service; no paid plan or trial established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费服务；未确认付费套餐或试用。

sources.title: Notes — notes.io

sources.title: Notes — notes.io
sources.research_notes_en: The same official page explicitly states free use; no paid checkout was inspected.

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.en: The documented flow is to write text and obtain a short link. An illustrative use is sharing non-sensitive event instructions through an existing message channel. No note was created in this research.
sections.zh: 文档流程是输入文字，再取得短链接。可用于通过现有消息渠道分享非敏感活动说明。本次没有创建笔记。

sections.en: The page warns that notes above 18 KB cannot be shortened without reducing content or signing in. Keep the original elsewhere, and verify the recipient link before relying on it. Password protection, deletion controls, retention and service recovery were not established.
sections.zh: 页面提示超过 18 KB 的内容需缩短或登录，才能生成短链接。建议在其他位置保存原文，依赖链接前核对接收者视图。未确认密码保护、删除控制、保留期或服务恢复能力。

sections.title_en: Free use is not a hosting guarantee
sections.en: The official page describes the service as free. No paid plan, trial, self-hosted package or source licence was verified. For durable private knowledge or attachments, investigate a product with explicit storage and access terms.
sections.zh: 官网将服务描述为免费。未核实付费套餐、试用、自行部署包或源码许可。若需长期私密知识库或附件，应调查具有明确存储与访问条款的产品。

research_gaps.en: No note creation, recipient access, recovery, retention, account behaviour or service licence was tested/verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试／核实笔记创建、接收者访问、恢复、保留期、账户行为或服务许可。
